note: The fixture pair for n-plus-one (L01a in fixtures/PLAN.md), raw SQL through pg form, scanned with n-plus-one alone. Written by hand: each planted defect is fixed in place in the clean twin, line for line, and the twins differ in nothing else. A finding catches a defect when its check matches and its locations name the defect's file, line, column and symbol (every place, when the defect lists several: the call made once per item, then the query inside a helper), with the defect's severity. Decoys are in both twins; reporting one is a false positive. Prisma is pinned at 7.10.1, whose batching research/prisma-batching.md records as observed. Paths are relative to each twin. Nothing here is installed or run.
